description: Duval factorization into nonincreasing byte Lyndon factors.
state: Immutable byte input; deterministic local algorithm state or finite oracle fixtures.
cost: O(n) byte comparisons and O(k) returned ranges, O(1) auxiliary words; no policy cap; Vec allocation semantics.
forward: At each unprocessed start compare scan and matched positions. Strict increase resets matched to start; equality advances it. On descent or EOF, period=scan-matched and emit period-length factors while start<=matched. Returned factors cover the input in order and are lexicographically nonincreasing Lyndon words.
inverse: behavior_complement first and ambiguous reverse_reconstruction second; see adjacent model.md
checks: Compiled implementation and oracle controls; repeated source syntax
limitations: Finite correspondence only; allocation failures not injected; no semantic AST or universal proof.
